edges: Virgin Media spokesman stated their efforts to balance competitive pricing while investing to meet customer demands.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Customers suffering from shoddy broadband service will welcome new measures for automatic compensation.
Customers reported an increase in complaints about price rises, with 47% reporting an increase in the last year.
Price was also the top complaint about BT, with 30% of customers reporting an increase.

edges: Customers reported feeling most dissatisfied with their service from Virgin Media.
